assumptions: The selected control is evaluated only for a classified licensed firm and an actual STR filing.
Unknown facts remain unknown rather than being treated as false.
Footnote 3 attaches to the XML and prescribed-PDF items because those items carry the marker; the web-form item does not carry it.

citations.quote: Licensed firms are required to submit STRs to the JFIU via STREAMS 2 by one of the following means:
submission of an STR in an Extensible Markup Language (XML) format3;
uploading a completed STR form in the prescribed PDF format3; or
completing the web-based STR form in STREAMS 2.
upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026
licensed firms that intend to submit STRs via the XML format are required to follow the XML schema provided separately by the JFIU
Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission.
for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;
For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2.

children.distinction: Retains the operational-launch reading: “following its implementation” begins at the explicit 9:00am launch, subject to the unresolved timestamp and timezone question. An off-channel STR filed at or after that point triggers a separate mandatory resubmission obligation. The blackout urgent-contact instruction remains separate and is not subjected to the post-launch channel control. Neither a deadline nor a duty to resubmit pre-launch urgent contacts is inferred. The original executable expression contains an undeclared is_xml_submission fact and an unresolved certificate-compliance predicate; evidence repair alone cannot establish an executable replacement.
questions: Does the source intend the launch timestamp, including its timezone, to define implementation?
Does an urgent contact made before launch later require resubmission, and by when?
What specific certificate condition must be assessed for XML and prescribed-PDF submissions?
What separately supplied XML schema governs conformity?
children.statement: [TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT] For a classified licensed firm’s actual STR filing at or after the operational launch, the firm MUST use STREAMS 2 and one listed submission method: XML conforming to the separately provided JFIU schema, upload of a completed prescribed PDF, or completion of the STREAMS 2 web form. The footnote 3 Hongkong Post e-Cert requirement MUST be met for XML or PDF. True means this selected filing control is satisfied; false means it is not satisfied. This does not decide whole-firm compliance or STR timeliness.
